stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Export and Dashboard must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Export and Dashboard must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Dashboard must be in position 1." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Alerts → Dashboard → Chat → Billing → Export
- Billing → Chat → Alerts → Dashboard → Export
- Billing → Export → Alerts → Dashboard → Chat
- Chat → Alerts → Dashboard → Billing → Export
- Chat → Billing → Alerts → Dashboard → Export
- Chat → Billing → Export → Alerts → Dashboard

distractorRationale.a: This is possible, as demonstrated by Alerts → Dashboard → Chat → Billing → Export, which obeys all the original conditions.
distractorRationale.b: This is possible, as demonstrated by Billing → Export → Alerts → Dashboard → Chat, which obeys all the original conditions.
distractorRationale.d: This is possible, as demonstrated by Billing → Chat → Alerts → Dashboard → Export, which obeys all the original conditions.
